_comment: twin of the guardian tank. The two deliberately fail in opposite ways: the guardian renews but
dies if its tank is bucketed dry, tailings cannot be destroyed but heaps do not regrow.
Prismarine Grit is a tailings_pulls find, because tailings are a mineral-processing residue and
that is where an odd silicate fraction concentrates - the same argument slag makes. It is the
quartz_grit shape exactly: a grit pulled from a garbage stream, divided by the Separator into a
gem-tier shard with glass shards as the silicate leftover. A grit rather than the tailings block
itself because every_separating_input_is_findable_scrap requires the feed to come out of a pull
stream, and Mill Tailings is a worldgen block you mine, not a thing anything drops.
